nextGame.note: Sunday road game at Chicago. Noon our time, on Fox 8. Five Saints are out, including center Erik McCoy and tackle Taliese Fuaga. Alvin Kamara practiced all week and is expected to play. Chicago has won seven games and lost two. The Saints have won three and lost six, and Carolina leads the division with four wins and five losses.

news.headline: Tyler Shough practices without the glove on his hand
news.summary: The Saints quarterback has been playing with two broken bones in his left hand, and this week he practiced without the glove he had been wearing over it. The team has not said the hand is healed.

news.headline: Five Saints are out for Sunday at Chicago
news.summary: Cornerback Martin Emerson, tackle Taliese Fuaga, center Erik McCoy, safety Justin Reid and tackle Asim Richards will all miss the game. Linebacker Pete Werner and cornerback Decamerion Richardson might play.

news.headline: Jordan Howden takes over at safety
news.summary: Justin Reid asked the Saints to let him go on Thursday after starting the first nine games. Jordan Howden, who is in his fourth year with the team, starts next to Julian Blackmon on Sunday.

nextGame.note: Saturday morning home game in Gainesville. Eleven o'clock our time, on the SEC Network. It is Florida's last home game of the year, and ten seniors are honored before kickoff. Florida has won six games and lost four and is already going to a bowl game. Vanderbilt has won four games and lost six.

news.headline: Ten Gators play their last home game Saturday
news.summary: Florida will honor ten players who are out of college eligibility before the Vanderbilt game, and six more may walk with them. Receiver Kahleil Jackson, now in his seventh year of college, is the oldest of the group.

news.headline: Sumrall did not like Tuesday's practice
news.summary: Florida's coach stopped a slow practice and made the team run six plays of full-contact goal line work. He said the Gators have not handled winning well this year.

news.headline: Five Florida players are out for Saturday
news.summary: Florida's injury list came out Wednesday night. Tight end Lacota Dippre, receiver Vernell Brown III, lineman Emeka Ugorji, safety DJ Coleman and lineman Jaden Robinson will all miss the Vanderbilt game.

nextGame.note: Saturday afternoon road game in Knoxville, Tennessee. Half past two our time, on ABC. LSU's two best receivers, Jackson Harris and Winston Watkins Jr., may not play. LSU has won six games and lost four. Tennessee has won eight games and lost two.

news.headline: LSU's two best receivers may not play
news.summary: Jackson Harris and Winston Watkins Jr. are both listed as questionable for Saturday at Tennessee. Between them they have caught 96 passes for 1,381 yards this season.

news.headline: Aidan Anding may play after a lost season
news.summary: The cornerback tore his Achilles tendon in a spring practice in April and has not played a game all year. LSU listed him as probable for Saturday at Tennessee.

news.headline: Whit Weeks is out for Saturday at Tennessee
news.summary: LSU's linebacker was listed as doubtful on Wednesday and is now officially out. Receivers Jackson Harris and Winnie Watkins are questionable.

news.headline: A win Saturday keeps Tulane in the title race
news.summary: Beating North Texas would make Tulane bowl eligible and keep the Green Wave alive for the conference championship game. North Texas has to start a backup quarterback because Tayven Jackson is hurt.

news.headline: Cooper Helmke is up for a national kicking award
news.summary: Tulane kicker Cooper Helmke is one of 20 players still in the running for the Lou Groza Award, which goes to the best kicker in the country. He has made 13 of his 15 field goals this year, and his longest was from 58 yards.

news.headline: Tulane's last road game is set for 2:30 Saturday
news.summary: Tulane plays at South Florida on Saturday, November 28, at half past two in the afternoon. The game is on ESPN+, which comes with YouTube TV at no extra charge.
